scope_note: A pilot, source-governed chronology of public announcements, milestones, ownership changes, incidents, controversies, and abandoned proposals. Events summarize what linked sources report; omission is not evidence that no other event occurred.

timelines.coverage_note: Pilot review follows the former GT Advanced facility from Apple's conversion announcement through operation and the reported second expansion phase.

events.title: Apple announces conversion of the former sapphire plant
events.summary: Apple said it would invest $2 billion over time to convert the vacant GT Advanced Technologies building into a global command center for its data network. Contemporary coverage tied the reuse to the supplier's bankruptcy and reported projections of 500 construction and 150 permanent jobs.

sources.title: Apple to build $2b data center in Arizona

events.title: Rooftop fire is extinguished during conversion period
events.summary: A second-alarm fire at the Mesa facility was extinguished within 35 minutes. Reporting said it appeared to originate near rooftop solar panels, did not spread inside, and caused no reported injuries.

sources.title: Apple Facility in Mesa, Arizona Catches Fire

events.title: Apple takes operational control of the building
events.summary: Apple's 2017 environmental report states that the company took operational control in October 2015 while converting the building into a data center.

events.title: Converted data center begins servicing customers
events.summary: Apple's environmental reporting identifies March 2017 as the start of customer service and says the Mesa data center was supplied with renewable energy from opening.

events.title: Second conversion phase reported underway
events.summary: Trade reporting said contractors were installing equipment and building supporting roads and infrastructure for the second of three planned phases; details of a third phase had not been announced.

sources.title: Apple close to finishing second phase of Mesa command center

timelines.coverage_note: Pilot review follows the Citadel campus from public plans through opening, later construction, ownership change, and a reported land-use dispute affecting adjacent development.

events.title: Switch details a planned seven-million-square-foot campus
events.summary: Switch described a $1 billion first stage east of Reno and a campus that could ultimately reach about seven million square feet and $3 billion in investment. The first stage was then expected to be commissioned in 2016.

sources.title: Switch plans 'largest data center in the world' in Reno

events.title: Tahoe Reno 1 opens at the Citadel campus
events.summary: Switch announced the opening of Tahoe Reno 1, describing the first building as up to 1.3 million square feet and 130 MW within a 2,000-acre campus.

sources.title: Switch TAHOE RENO Now Open: Largest, Most Advanced Data Center Campus in the World

events.title: Construction accelerates on Tahoe Reno 2 and site work begins for 3
events.summary: Switch said Tahoe Reno 1 was more than 80 percent committed and announced accelerated construction of Tahoe Reno 2 plus site preparation for Tahoe Reno 3 following customer expansions.

sources.title: Switch Breaks Ground on Second and Third Tahoe Reno Data Centers

events.title: DigitalBridge and IFM complete the Switch take-private
events.summary: Funds affiliated with DigitalBridge and IFM Investors acquired all outstanding Switch common shares in a transaction valued at approximately $11 billion including debt repayment. Switch continued as the campus operator under private ownership.

sources.title: DigitalBridge and IFM Investors Complete $11 Billion Take-Private of Switch

events.title: Court narrows Switch's reading of an adjacent-land covenant
events.summary: In litigation over land inside and next to the Tahoe-Reno Industrial Center, a Nevada judge issued partial summary judgment favoring Tract's narrower reading of a covenant. Both companies publicly maintained competing positions while other claims remained pending.
events.scope_note: The reported dispute concerns adjacent development rights and access; it is not evidence of an operating failure at Tahoe Reno 1.

sources.title: Tract scores courtroom victory over Switch as Nevada data center dispute trial inches closer

timelines.coverage_note: Pilot review distinguishes the completed DX-1 facility from later site-expansion proposals, including a separate CoreWeave-linked agreement that expired in 2026.

events.title: Developers break ground at the former State Line power plant
events.summary: Construction began on a planned $40 million, 105,000-square-foot first data-center building on the former coal-plant site. Reporting said the broader campus concept could add three similar facilities.

sources.title: Developers break ground on Chicago State Line data center

events.title: DX-1's first phase is completed
events.summary: Digital Crossroad completed the first phase of the 105,000-square-foot building and began moving tenant servers into the facility. Contemporary reporting described 17 direct employees and further tenant staffing expected.

sources.title: Digital Crossroad finishes $40m Lake Michigan data center in Indiana

events.title: $28 million committed for continued DX-1 buildout
events.summary: Energy Solutions Group and United Leasing and Finance announced $28 million for the next phase of the facility after completion of its initial 6 MW phase.

sources.title: Digital Crossroad receives $28 million to expand Indiana data center

events.title: A larger second-phase building is proposed
events.summary: Digital Crossroad said the existing facility was full and described plans for another 180,000 square feet and 20 MW, subject to approvals and a later groundbreaking.

sources.title: Digital Crossroad plans expansion of Hammond data center campus outside Chicago

events.title: Power, jobs, water, and lakefront access draw public questions
events.summary: At a mayoral public event, local officials addressed questions about grid capacity, utility bills, water use, permanent employment, and lakefront access. The mayor said uncertainty about available power was preventing a major deal from closing.
events.scope_note: The report records public questions and officials' responses; it does not establish that DX-1 caused a grid or water-system failure.

sources.title: Data center concerns raised during Hammond Mayor's Night Out event

events.title: Separate CoreWeave-linked development agreement expires
events.summary: Hammond said a development agreement for a proposed project at 301 Digital Crossroads expired after two extensions because required milestones and obligations were not completed by June 30. The city said it would not offer another extension under that agreement.
events.scope_note: This was a later proposed development involving the city, redevelopment commission, Decennial Group, and CoreWeave; it does not mean the existing DX-1 facility closed.

sources.title: Hammond Announces Expiration of Data Center Development Agreement
